items.text:
Update - 100h later:
I played again, because of the Bugfixes & QOL updates. Sure - I want to love the game. But it's still soooo slow. It's great for the option to build your ship, scrap some derelics, and all the other things. But the "Auto-..." features are not very stable, so you have to babysit your char like crazy. This combined with the small transport-capacity of the char makes me play for 4 hours of my lifetime, only to uninstall & dismantle parts of a derelic and transport some parts to my one ship. 
No, simply no. Once again: deinstall!


This game is way to slow, the pace is indcredible slow. In 4 hours realtime I created a char and visited 2 ships. The first: Not much loot, only scrap - ok. The  second ship had a pirate on the front door. First action: He took all my stuff. No, I think I quit for now, uninstall and take a look in a year or so.
items.text_zh:
更新 - 100小时后：
我又玩了，因为修复漏洞和生活质量更新。当然——我想爱上这款游戏。但它还是太太太慢了。能建造你的飞船、拆解一些废弃船以及所有其他事情是很棒的选项。但那些“自动……”功能不太稳定，所以你得疯狂地照看你的角色。再加上角色那小小的运输容量，让我花了4小时的人生，只为了卸载并拆解一艘废弃船的部分，然后把一些部件运到我的唯一一艘飞船上。
不，就是不。再说一次：卸载！


这款游戏太慢了，节奏慢得难以置信。在4小时实时时间里，我创建了一个角色并访问了2艘飞船。第一艘：没多少战利品，只有废料——好吧。第二艘飞船前门有个海盗。第一个动作：他拿走了我所有的东西。不，我想我现在不玩了，卸载，大概一年后再看看。

observations.evidence: This game is way to slow, the pace is indcredible slow
observations.evidence_zh: 这游戏太慢了，节奏慢得令人难以置信
